fieldNotes.facility: Positively identified: Street View on the west perimeter road shows the DMAX logo on the building face with red dock doors and a Duramax-branded tractor in the fenced yard (pano CvcXabIhcUviMHwYg0r22g). This is the DMAX Ltd diesel engine plant at 3100 Dryden Rd, a distinct building from the former GM Moraine Assembly (now Fuyao Glass America) further south.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Continuous chain-link perimeter fence confirmed on all sides via multiple Street View angles. The truck/yard entrance is at the NW corner off the Dryden Rd intersection where the internal loop/perimeter road enters the secured yard.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth at the truck lane positively visible in satellite or Street View; entrances read as fenced/gated. Auto-plant sites at this scale frequently have a gatehouse, so this is flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Inferred from a gated, fully fenced entrance with no clearly visible staffed booth at the truck lane; uncertain (see guardShack).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors on two faces: a long red-doored bank on the west/SW face (visible in Street View, ~trailers backed in) and a row on the east/SE face with multiple trailers backed in (zoom-19 imagery). 25-50 band; exact count approximate.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two physically separate dock clusters on the west and east building faces.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-parking lots with trailers parked in marked rows: a drop yard SE of the building (toward the rail/solar buffer) and trailer rows along the west yard. dropArea 25-50.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved yard apron inside the fence on west and south faces provides post-gate holding before docks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gated apron at the NW entrance and broad internal perimeter roads leave ample paved width for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: A multi-track main-line rail corridor runs immediately east of the property, but a wooded buffer separates it from the plant and no spur is visible entering the fenced DMAX property; railServed set false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the Dayton OH metro industrial fabric (Moraine), surrounded by other plants, rail, and dense residential; Urban.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale/weigh pad clearly identified; left uncertain.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~37.5 acres derived from the fenced-perimeter polygon; building footprint plus surrounding yards and parking.
